seriesPage.title: Series
seriesPage.subtitle: Prestige ranking and P4P weights · {year}
seriesPage.prestigeLead: Featured championships ranked by how hard they are relative to each other. The coefficient S feeds directly into pound-for-pound (P4P) scores.

overlap.title: 1. Pilot overlap
overlap.body: For drivers in 2+ featured series, S is the mean indexPoints across all events in that series. For target series X: P = S_X − S_Y. Hardness(X) = −mean(P) over all overlap pairs. Higher hardness means a tougher series.

coefficient.title: 2. Series coefficient S
coefficient.body: After ranking series by accumulated hardness, we convert rank to a weight. Top series gets S = 1.000, the last gets 1/N.

p4p.title: 3. Pound-for-pound (P4P)
p4p.body: Each pilot's best score across featured series standings:
p4p.note: P = championship place in that series. Only the single best S/P counts.

indexPoints.title: 4. Event indexPoints
indexPoints.body: Each event result is scored with a grid-strength factor k (Top32 reference).
indexPoints.note: k = 1 − 1/n + 1/32, where n is scoring drivers in the top-32 qual grid.

noData.title: 5. Series without overlap
noData.body: Featured series with no overlap pairs get no hardness score and are listed at the bottom — no manual ranking.
